title: Career-changer junior frontend engineer (math teacher to React)
description: A former high-school math teacher (5 years) turned junior frontend engineer (1 year, React/TypeScript) evaluated against 8 postings: one strong junior React match with clear gaps, one solid entry-level frontend role, an ed-tech math-content marginal, a math-teaching distractor, and four unrelated roles.
rationale: Stresses the career-changer + junior family: the resume's dominant experience by volume is five years of high-school math teaching, but its professional identity (summary, skills list, most recent role) is junior frontend engineering. j1 is the strongest junior React match and the gap target: Next.js and GraphQL are required but absent from the resume (high severity), Storybook and Cypress are preferred and absent (low), while strong React/TypeScript/Tailwind/Jest overlap and a matching 1+ year requirement justify grade 3. j4 (a math-teaching posting) is a deliberate distractor: it matches the candidate's past career, not the target one, testing whether the matcher keys on current professional identity rather than raw years of prior experience — grade 0. j3 (ed-tech math content development) is the graded boundary: genuine overlap with the teaching background plus light HTML/CSS, but a content role rather than an engineering one — grade 1.

jobs.raw_text:
Junior Frontend Engineer — Findora (Hybrid, Portland OR)

Findora builds budgeting tools used by 200k households. Our web team is hiring a junior engineer to grow with us.

What you will do:
- Build customer-facing features in React and TypeScript within our Next.js app
- Write unit tests with Jest and React Testing Library for every feature
- Implement responsive, accessible UI from Figma designs using Tailwind CSS
- Collaborate through Git pull requests and participate in code review

Requirements: React, TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, GraphQL client integration. 1+ years of professional frontend experience and experience shipping production React features. Bachelor's degree or an accredited bootcamp certificate.

Nice to have: Storybook, Cypress end-to-end testing, Figma familiarity.

Curriculum Content Developer, Mathematics — LearnLoop (Remote, US)

LearnLoop builds adaptive math practice used in 2,000 schools. We are hiring a content developer to author our algebra and pre-calculus item banks.

You will write and review interactive math exercises, define hints and misconception feedback, and tag items to state standards. You will partner with engineers to prototype new interactive item types, occasionally adjusting HTML/CSS templates.

Requirements: strong secondary-math subject expertise, curriculum or classroom experience, clear instructional writing. 2+ years teaching or in content development. Bonus: basic HTML/CSS, familiarity with learning management systems.

High School Mathematics Teacher — Westfield Preparatory Academy (Onsite, Portland OR)

Westfield Prep is a private secondary school of 600 students. We seek a full-time mathematics teacher for Algebra II and AP Calculus starting this fall.

You will teach five sections, develop assessments aligned to our honors curriculum, advise a student club, and communicate progress with families each quarter.

Requirements: state teaching license or eligibility, strong classroom management, experience teaching upper-level high-school mathematics. Bachelor's degree in Mathematics or Math Education. 3+ years of classroom teaching preferred. Bonus: experience coaching math competition teams.
